name: CssToInlineStyles
description: CssToInlineStyles is a class that enables you to convert HTML-pages/files into HTML-pages/files with inline styles. This is very usefull when you're sending emails.

issues.title: Typed property DOMDocument::$documentElement must not be accessed before initialization
Void elements are no longer closed when using xhtml
Any plans on adding CSS variables support?
Add ability to override existing inline styles
